summary: Both corpus passages are already cited; no new stem, box, sense, example or idiom is needed. The delta intentionally has no stem changes.
Detransitive Part. Pass. mʕafnəko with natino denotes spoiled straw as a state. Preterit mʕafnakke describes grain having gone mouldy, without a deliberate actor or expressed object.

Non-agentive semantics does not itself justify moving the inherited active Preterit example to Detransitive. The supplied root has both formal paradigms; preserve the existing allocation and exact forms.

Confirm the precise person/number segmentation of mʕafnakke in 113/18; the non-agentive grain referent and Preterit meaning are clear, but the reader’s categorical 3sg label is not independently demonstrated by this form.
Restore the adjective ending in “hässliche Stute”.
rationale: The adjective modifying the feminine singular Stute after eine requires -e. This is an evident inflectional slip, also present in the supplied corpus translation.
The object is accusative masculine Häcksel. The supplied edition translation reads “stinkenden, faulen Häcksel”, confirming that -en has been lost.
